title: Image content
description: The `image` content block, carrying base64-encoded data and its MIME type.
question: Does an image result survive adaptation, or is it dropped or flattened to text?
notes: An image result stays an image in both adapters that reach 2026-07-28; 3 cannot reach the revision.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI 1.15.1 requires MCP Python SDK 1.26.x, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.2: LangChain MCP Adapters 0.3.2 requires mcp<2.0.0, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.3: Mastra 1.17.3 negotiated MCP 2025-11-25. The scanner refused to compare that capture with a 2026-07-28 source.

verdict.headline: Images survive as images in both adapters that reach 2026-07-28.
verdict.detail: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0 emits an image output item and Pydantic AI 2.40.0 returns a `BinaryImage`. This is the one non-text content kind both adapters carry without flattening it. CrewAI, LangChain and Mastra cannot negotiate MCP 2026-07-28, so they reach none of it.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: A dropped image block is a silent failure: the call succeeds, the result arrives, and the payload the tool existed to return is simply gone.
